posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.25.0
posts.summary: The first stable release in over a year. Two iterators can now be used together, as long as they are the same length.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.24.0
posts.summary: Conditional branching, a skipped state for nodes, selectable themes, and PyTorch upscaling roughly 1.25x faster than before.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.19.0
posts.summary: Searchable documentation for every node, a rewritten update screen, backend setup changes, and the first Rust code in chaiNNer.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: One year of chaiNNer
posts.summary: A year on from the first public release — what's planned for the year ahead, a website, and the beginnings of a model database.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.16.0
posts.summary: A much more compact node design, inserting a node onto an existing connection, explanations for invalid connections, sharper previews, and DDS support on Windows.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.14.0
posts.summary: Video support rebuilt on a full FFmpeg build, and auto-tiling reworked to use real tile sizes instead of a split factor.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.13.0
posts.summary: GFPGAN face restoration arrives as the Face Upscale node, and the repository moves to the chaiNNer-org organization.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.12.0
posts.summary: Direct PyTorch to NCNN conversion, SwinIR support, faster PyTorch auto-tiling, and lower RAM overhead on large chains.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.11.0
posts.summary: Image previews inside the editor, via a new View Image node and a rework of how previews and starting nodes work.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.10.1
posts.summary: Nodes already on the canvas can be dragged into an iterator, and released back out again.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.10.0
posts.summary: The Navi type system, colored handles that show you what connects to what, a node search context menu, and the ability to disable nodes.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.5.0
posts.summary: Batch upscaling arrives, through a new kind of node called an iterator, along with DDS and TGA support via Pillow.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.3.0
posts.summary: NCNN support brings upscaling to AMD and Intel GPUs, and every node gets renamed and recategorized around what it does rather than what implements it.

posts.author: joey
posts.title: Alpha v0.1.0
posts.summary: The initial alpha release, and the first day of chaiNNer being public.
